This year I will put my energy into this maize plot since it feeds my family. I managed to get the FISP coupon this season, so I will buy the subsidized NPK and urea — without that I could never afford full fertilizer on my own. I will plant hybrid seed that came with the coupon because the yield is much better than the local seed I kept from last year, and since I am intercropping with beans, the beans will help the soil too. I cannot afford to hire much labor, but during weeding time I will call a few ganyu workers for a couple of days to keep up with the rains.
